newsitem.title: USA: Developers Diversified raises annual div.
newsitem.headline: Developers Diversified raises annual div.

text.p: Developers Diversified Realty Corp said Thursday that its board has increased the annualized dividend for 1997 to $2.52 per share, or $.63 per share per quarter.
The company said the increase from $2.40 reflects the company's continued growth through leasing, expansion, acquisition and development in 1996.

The company said the new dividend produces a more conservative payout ratio that will let it retain more capital for investment opportunities in the development, acquisition, and expansion of portfolio properties.
